visualCharacteristics: A wrapping horizontal row of linked partner or external banner images, optionally under a heading.
contentPattern: Optional first row: a heading. Then one row per banner: a link paragraph wrapping a picture, whose alt text names the link.
usage: Use it to list partner or external site banners as a row of image links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any row of linked logo or banner images; use cards when each item needs text as well.
